body:
Hi @stelem unfortunately [searchableAttributes](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-parameters/searchableAttributes/) is a setting parameter. It can't be changed with search parameters.

On the Algolia side, one way is to rely on primary / secondary with different searchableAttributes.

And then switch the index on the fly. You can use the [sortBySelector](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/sortBySelector.html) for that. But since you mentioned that you wanted a checkbox, then you probably want to have a look at the [connector](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors/connectSortBySelector.html).
